facebook.caption:
This place fixes burnout faster than any resort pool.

Dinh Cậu sits right at the edge of Phu Quoc's harbor. A small shrine to the sea goddess, a blue-and-white lighthouse, fishing boats drifting past. Locals come here to pray. Tourists come at sunset and don't leave.

4.5 stars across 3,552 reviews. Quiet, free, and somehow the most grounding 30 minutes on the island.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the fishing boats come in as the sun drops behind Dinh Cậu. Free to visit. Zero crowds at the right hour. This is the Phu Quoc nobody puts in the brochure.
